name: partner-report
description: Collect complete Codex project-session turns on a configurable Scheduled task and sync structured facts to Partner Report.

interface.shortDescription: Build a reviewed weekly Partner report
interface.longDescription: On a Codex Scheduled task, initially set to 13:00 Beijing time, use the task's active model to extract structured facts from complete project-session turns and upload them for central aggregation and two-stage web review. Users can change the schedule, model, reasoning effort, and notifications in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use $partner-report-sync to connect this Codex installation with an Admin binding code.
Use $partner-report-sync to run daily-collect and return the safe summary.
